name: Aurelion Sol
notes: Aurelion Sol never attacks: his damage is entirely abilities and a channel that fills the fight, so attack.never is set and items that key on attacks or attack speed get no value.

Cosmic Creator's Stardust count is held at a fixed assumed value (gen.P.assumedStacks) for the whole fight rather than tracked live, since it feeds three formulas at once and its growth within a single 8-15s fight is small next to a realistic level-16 total.

Breath of Light's target-max-health burst bonus is dealt as true damage, per the bin's field and function names (QMaxHealthTrueDamagePerStack, BurstBonusTrueDamageToChamps), separately from the burst's flat+AP magic damage, even though the ability-wide tooltip calls the whole ability 'magic damage'.

Breath of Light has no cast time and is cast once at the start; its channel is treated as never-ending and never-interrupted for the whole fight: the beam ticks every 0.125s and its burst fires every full second, reading the ranked 3.25s channel cap and its automatic recast as a seamless, zero-downtime continuation (the more common in-game reading) so it never actually matters.

Singularity (E) has a 0.2s cast time, which is tracked (gen.E.castTimeS) and keeps Aurelion Sol busy (no other cast starts inside it): it is cast as soon as it is off cooldown and after any cast in progress, and is assumed not to interrupt Breath of Light's channel, since the wiki's interrupt-on-cast rule is only stated for casts made during Astral Flight's dash; its own cooldown starts when its 5s duration ends (post-effect), after the black hole appears 0.5s from the start of the cast (a delay that already contains the 0.2s cast time).

Falling Star has no cast time and is cast once at t=0; with the assumed Stardust count already past 75, it is cast as its empowered form, The Skies Descend, and only its star-impact damage is dealt, since the wiki states a target hit by the impact is immune to the shockwave, so the dummy (always hit by the impact) never takes shockwave damage.

Astral Flight (W) is never cast: on a stationary dummy its only combat effect is a temporary buff to Breath of Light's flat damage while dashing, which needs a dash duration/distance the engine does not model, and its cooldown-reset-and-extend effect on Breath of Light is worthless since the channel is already continuous; its 0.375s cast time is therefore never charged.
Singularity's and Falling Star's execute thresholds are not modeled: the engine has no execute primitive and this dummy fight only checks total damage dealt.
Mana costs are not modeled; nothing here would actually stall casts within a 15s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: permanent Stardust stacks a level-16 champion plausibly has accumulated by this point in a game; held fixed through the fight since in-fight growth (roughly 5-15 stacks over 15s) is negligible against this baseline, and Q's true-damage term, E's execution threshold and R's Skies Descend unlock all key off of it

unused.W: Astral Flight's only combat effect against a stationary dummy is a temporary buff to Breath of Light's flat damage while dashing, and its Breath-of-Light cooldown reset/extension is worthless since the channel is already treated as continuous; its dash distance/duration also is not something the engine models. It is never cast, so its 0.375s cast time is never charged.
